# A firefly, the bonus: a glowing body and two pale wings, about 0.3 m across (exaggerated). Up Z,
# origin at its body.
new
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.1 --location 0 0 0
material new Glow --base-color 1.0 0.804 0.459
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name WingL --size 1 --location -0.15 0.02 0.06
scale 0.2 0.12 0.03
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -20 0
add mesh cube --name WingR --size 1 --location 0.15 0.02 0.06
scale 0.2 0.12 0.03
apply --scale
set rotation 0 20 0
material new Wing --base-color 0.957 0.957 0.957
select WingL WingR
material assign Wing
select all
shade flat
export fly.glb
